notes.title: Ver. 1.10 Update
notes.content:
Today we have a little update for everyone looking forward to [i]Giraffe And Annika[/i]!

[b]Update Contents[/b]
[list]
[*]Added「Reload most recent recovery point.」function to the pause menu.
[*]Added the following message before the Goddess Dance event.
「By performing the dance and progressing the story, there will be collectibles that will no longer be accessible. We recommend you create a separate save file before progressing.」
[*]Various minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Untitled
notes.content:
Today we have a little update for everyone looking forward to [i]Giraffe And Annika[/i]!

[b]Update Contents[/b]
-Full-screen mode has been fixed, and tearing no longer occurs
-Rail car difficulty level adjusted
 *Flame damage reduced; R stick no longer controls camera; camera movement now reflects analog input to make aiming easier
-Respawn points added to the back half of Dungeon 5; difficulty level adjusted
-Game will now only detect keyboard or gamepad when starting the game; toggle settings function added
-Screen showing controls for several seconds when starting the game and entering dungeons added
-Floating/sinking keyboard controls switched from "Shift" to "Q" and "E" while in water
-Changed Christmas achievement explanatory text
-Fixed several bugs and errors that were preventing progress

notes.title: Ver. 1.02 Update
notes.content:
For all those playing [i]Giraffe And Annika[/i], we've released an update!

[b]Update Contents[/b]
[list]
[*] Motion blur can now be turned ON/OFF in Options
[*] Digital pad can now be used to move the character
[*] Various user-reported bugs preventing progression and causing the character to get stuck have also been fixed
[/list]
